q1_issues.issue: The secondary predicate "untended" is emitted only as the flat (Member sk_lantern_1 untended), but "leave X untended" is the maintenance resultative the instruction set illustrates with "kept the gate shut", which requires the State-result shape beside the flat atom — a reified state witness with its Experiencer, the (Result sk_leave_1 <state>) link, and (Still <state>) for the continuation.

notes: Everything else conforms: a witness for the indefinite subject with a verbal predicate, no status atom for the bare simple present, "overnight" as the day-part constant night, Theme for the unchanged object of a maintenance verb, and Middle Row as a name with its separate kind atom (Member middle_row row) and no modifier genus. Attaching "on the Middle Row" to the lantern rather than to the leaving is the favored reading, so the single-reading default is right.
